method: Read-only source, requirement, audit, report, and asserting-test inspection. No tests, browser journeys, migrations, or database operations were executed for this audit. This is not an independent phase review or sign-off.
working_tree_note: The automation files were being edited by another agent after this source revision was inspected. The automation finding describes aea5d5702 only and must be rechecked on the integrated tree.

findings.summary: Project automation management checks project:manage_settings rather than the documented automation:manage capability.
evidence: packages/permissions/src/capabilities.ts:484 grants automation:manage for project rules; packages/permissions/src/roles.ts grants it to lead without project:manage_settings
docs/technical/permissions.md:87 describes automation:manage as project-rule authority
apps/api/src/automation/access.ts:103-130 uses project:manage_settings for manage operations
apps/api/src/automation/policy.ts:39-90 declares project:manage_settings or workspace:manage_settings, never automation:manage
findings.impact: A lead with the named automation capability cannot manage project rules, while a custom role with project settings authority but no automation capability can.
findings.next_action: Inspect the concurrent fix and add an HTTP test distinguishing lead, custom automation-only, and project-settings-only roles.

findings.summary: Cost-to-deliver drill does not list all records behind its displayed actual.
evidence: apps/api/src/report/reports/leadership.ts:247-315 includes cost_entry amounts and budget-period actuals
apps/api/src/report/reports/drill-extra.ts:175-184 returns time_entry rows only, filtered to the report window
tests/api-integration/p5-reports-drill.test.ts:205 exercises cost_to_deliver without a cost-entry assertion
findings.impact: A user cannot reconcile the displayed budget actual from the drill, despite the RP-12 underlying-items claim.
findings.next_action: Add cost-entry drill records under the same reach and rate checks; align row-specific budget periods, and assert the drill population reconciles with a budget containing both time and cost entries.

findings.summary: Phase status and generated report disagree with their cited audits and the current source tree.
evidence: docs/report/audit/audit-P4c.json has 106 implemented_tested, 36 partial, 5 implemented_untested, 4 missing, 1 external_blocked, and 20 browser_verified=true items; docs/report/data.json reports 112 tested and 30 partial, while docs/status.md:3 says no P4/P5 screen was browser-verified
docs/report/audit/audit-P5.json has 63 implemented_tested and 21 partial; docs/report/data.json and docs/status.md report 62 and 22

docs/report/data.json:251-301 and report.html describe P5 as uncommitted, integration unrun, and review round 5 pending; docs/status.md:14-21 says committed/pushed, 5011/5011 integration, and round 8 pass

apps/api/drizzle/0155_p5_cost_and_capacity.sql defines cost_entry and available_hours; apps/api/drizzle/0156_p5_report_snapshots.sql defines metric_snapshot, contradicting the P5 carry text saying these are absent
docs/report/review contains review-p4-round1.json but no stored P4 rounds 2-5 or P5 review artifacts
findings.impact: Counts, browser evidence, carry lists, and phase-review provenance cannot be relied on as a current consolidated status.
findings.next_action: Re-audit changed requirement rows, reconcile browser evidence definitions, preserve final review records, then regenerate data.json and report.html through the report scripts.

findings.summary: The active legacy task JSON importer is not the P6 import path and reruns can create duplicates.
evidence: apps/api/src/task/index.ts:474-506 registers POST /api/task/import/{projectId} and accepts an array without a P6 run or mapping reference

apps/api/src/task/controllers/import-tasks.ts:33-224 creates legacy task rows one by one, coerces status and priority, and returns individual results without a source-id ledger, dry-run, checkpoint, provenance, or source authorship
apps/api/src/database/schema.ts:1733-1759 external_link is task-only; apps/api/src/external-link/index.ts exposes only a task-link read
packages/mcp/src/tools/register.ts:38-43 says bulk_create_work_items, create_import_link, and get_import_link are not offered
findings.impact: Using this endpoint for cutover would violate idempotency and preservation requirements.
findings.next_action: Keep it distinct from P6, and move P6 writes through the new authenticated run/ledger/bulk API.

spot_checks.method: Read the cited asserting tests and source for implemented_tested audit rows; no test execution is claimed.

P4.assertion: Stored implication closure, rank/description, role.created audit and clone independence.
At-or-above-rank edit and rank lift return 403; lower-role edit succeeds.
Team API path and retained team until pending deletion approval.
Custom-field list and section creation only; audit itself notes field-create/update lacks an HTTP integration test.
Project overrides workspace overrides instance, with inherited-source response.
In-app enabled; email enabled for assignment, mention, approval and SLA breach; other external defaults off.
AND condition semantics and a nonmatching persisted rule.
Known HMAC vector and exact raw-body bytes; delivery signing path.
Key capability/project clamp and owner-state checks cited by the audit; current-tree execution not established here.
Idempotency-Key header is forwarded; write without a key is refused.

P5.assertion: Overlap returns 409 naming the conflicting cycle; concurrent overlapping creates yield one winner.
One module per item; moving module preserves an independent cycle.
Preview does not apply; clearing requires confirmation; applied result matches preview and persisted points.
Integer minutes, actor, activity, billable default and audit; rejects invalid minute amounts.
A second server read returns the timer start and activity; this does not prove a browser reload.
Customer is refused across report and dashboard routes with feature on and off.
Portal list, deflection and detail require published, customer-visible articles.
Impact walk returns depth, via-service and customers; cycle flag is asserted.
Calendar lists freeze and detects same-service overlapping change conflict.
Notes generate from linked changes, an edit persists, and explicit regeneration updates them.

P6_plan.name: Resolve recovery and authority contracts
P6_plan.work: Specify durable checkpoint/cursor ownership, source-change behavior, and backup/restore versus whole-run undo. Resolve old create_import_mapping versus maintained create_import_link/get_import_link names as one API. Register instance-admin route policies and key capability boundaries before writes.
P6_plan.gap: docs/technical/import-and-cutover.md#reconciliation-and-cutover-gaps explicitly leaves checkpoint shape, stale-source semantics and whole-run rollback undefined.

P6_plan.name: Common run, mapping and dry-run core
P6_plan.work: Create import_run, editable import_mapping_profile, unique import_record_link, generalized external_link provenance, audited APIs for create/list/detail/discover/mapping/dry-run/execute/pause/report and transactional checkpointed chunks. Make every unmapped or rejected value visible.

P6_plan.name: Source adapters and history
P6_plan.work: Add ADO, Plane, Jira/JSM, Planner, Power Apps and CSV discovery and editable value mapping. Preserve source authors and timestamps, inactive unmatched people, comments, attachments, relations and activity; require explicit state maps. Use general 500-item chunks, ADO 200-item chunks and separately chunked ADO revisions.

P6_plan.name: Agent path through the same run
P6_plan.work: Implement /api/imports/{id}/records and /links plus bounded MCP bulk_create_work_items, create_import_link and get_import_link on the same ledger. Enforce idempotency, rate caps, owner-clamped API-key capability, audit origin and no second privileged write path.

P6_plan.name: Kaneo UI, reconciliation and rehearsal
P6_plan.work: Build God Mode run history and editable mapping table from Kaneo/packages/ui, with affected counts, loss report and instance-topic progress. On isolated copies test interrupt/resume/rerun, count and source spot-check reconciliation, files/history/links, backup restore and per-source retirement approval. Do not claim whole-run undo or atomic cutover without its separate contract.
